name: Just Us! Wolfville Coffee House
desc:
Founded in 1995 as Canada's 1st fair trade coffee roaster, Just Us! is a worker-owned co-operative exclusively roasting specialty grade, certified fair trade organic coffee, primarily supplied by product carrying the Small Producer Symbol (SPP). We work hard to preserve the integrity of our supply chain, from seed to cup.

Just Us! pays well above the fair trade minimum to the small coffee co-operatives we work with as an authentic exchange for the high quality, organic, product received. Fair trade certification reduces coffee pricing volatility and helps organized small producer co-operative farms make real changes in their communities.

Small and organic is beautiful. Just Us! only purchases coffee from a network of democratically run small producers. We believe organic farming provides solutions to many of our current challenges like climate change, women’s rights, food sovereignty and Indigenous rights.

name: Charts Café
desc: Charts Cafe is a locally owned business serving North Mountain coffee and delicious homemade goods. We serve breakfast and lunch as well as delicious baked goods all day long. All the baked goods, soups, salads, sandwiches and compass buns (cinnamon buns) are made daily in house to ensure the best quality and homemade deliciousness. Ingredients are sourced locally when possible including meat from Oulton Farms and produce from the valley. We also host Farm to Table Dinners each season, partnering with local producers. We at Charts feel strongly about supporting local businesses and the community we are a part of.

name: Deep Roots Music
desc: The Deep Roots Music Festival takes place annually during the last full weekend of September. The Festival features ticketed and free events including open-air concerts, soft seat main-stage shows, songwriters' circles, and intimate performances. It also includes participatory workshops in drumming, dancing, and singing, workshops involving art and craft, music programs for children, and a colorful rhythm parade down Main Street with giant puppets.

name: The Real Scoop
desc: The Real Scoop Ice Cream & Espresso Shop. Serving Ice Cream, Sorbet & Waffle Cones made on site from scratch with REAL ingredients plus so many more dessert options. While visiting our shop, be sure to try one of our espresso drinks. www.RealScoop.ca

name: Paddy’s Brewpub & Rosie’s Restaurant
desc:
Enjoy a scrumptious meal or a delicious hand-crafted beer
or cider served by the friendliest servers in town at
Paddy’s Brewpub & Rosie’s Restaurant! With 12 taps – 11
beers and 1 cider, all brewed in-house – we have something
for every taste. Pair your beer with a delicious meal in
either our relaxed traditional Irish brewpub or in our
family restaurant. Check in with us for live entertainment
– a local music hotspot, we’ve always got something going
on.

Paddy’s was the first brewpub to open in the Valley in
1992 – the second microbrewery to open in all of the
Maritimes – and we’ve only gotten better at everything we
do!

name: Roselawn Lodging
desc:
Located in the beautiful town of Wolfville, Nova Scotia.
Our unique property nestled outside of the busy Wolfville downtown core gives guests the opportunity to enjoy a true home away from home.

name: Wolfville Farmers Market
desc: Experience the abundance of our community, its fertile land and its creative and hard-working people, all in one place. Started in 1992 with three vendors in a parking lot, we are now a year-round market on Saturdays (from 8:30am to 1:00pm) with over 70 farmers, chefs and artisan vendors and on Wednesdays (from 4:00pm to 7:00pm) with a Market Supper, community themes and live music. We are farmers, leaders, and passion-driven creators who are working to grow more and waste less while building a legacy of rich soil. Meet expert vendors whose hands have grown or created thousands of products that nourish, plus live music, programming for kids, all under the roof of our turn of the century home. With a community conscience, we offer an experience that connects you to generations past, while feeding generations now, and those on their way. Get replenished, get nourished, become a part of the market community.

name: Lahara Yoga
desc:
Since opening our doors in 2015, we've been committed to creating a community of individuals living free from mental and physical pain.

We are a yoga studio & wellness centre offering daily yoga classes, special events, massage therapy, reiki healing sessions and an infrared sauna.

Our goal is to create a safe and non-judgmental space where we hope to support the highest good within each other. We offer classes, courses, and workshops that shed light on interpreting and incorporating the nature of yoga, wellness and other forms of healing modalities with all aspects of life.

In our treatment rooms we have a full time massage therapist who is also certified in RAPID release and a part time athletic therapist who trained to recognize, assess, treat and manage a concussion from onset of injury to return to play. Both are both highly professional and more than happy to assist in any stage of your healing journey.

The yoga studio is also available for private rentals for one-on-one classes, birthday parties, bachelorette or any special event.

We are pleased to offer free outdoor yoga in the Waterfront Park every Saturday at 11am during the summer months.

name: Annapolis Cider
desc:
Tap into the Valley! The Annapolis Cider Company is all about local. We get our apples from nearby orchards, have them pressed into juice just down the road, and ferment the juice into cider on Main Street, Wolfville.

Visitors to the cidery can view the cider-making process by peering directly into the cellar, while enjoying a selection of our ciders at the tasting bar.

The cidery is open 7 days a week, offers tours and tastings, and has a spacious retail shop featuring a large selection of premium and specialty ciders.

name: Herbin Jewellers
desc: Herbin Jewellers is a family-owned and operated jewellery store located in the heart of Wolfville. Now in our fifth generation, we continue to offer unique fine jewellery, Canadian designer lines and exceptional customer service. Our experienced and GIA accredited staff are excited to share their knowledge and caring to everyone who visits our store! To learn more about what we offer visit www.herbinjewellers.com.

name: EOS Natural Foods
desc: Eos Natural Foods has been filling healthy pantries of the Wolfville and greater community for over 46 years. We offer whole, organic, and local foods, spices, and teas. At Eos, one of our goals is to inspire our customers to cook and share more meals from scratch using our whole food ingredients. We believe this is a cornerstone to sustaining good health throughout life! We also offer a range of nutritional supplements, clean cosmetics, and zero waste household products to complement healthful lifestyles.

name: T.A.N. Coffee
desc: T.A.N.Coffee strives to bring you the best in our Single-Origin Specialty Arabicas. All our coffees are craft croastec in small batches, to ensure our customers get the freshest cup of coffee with optimal smoothness, body, flavour and aroma - all fair trade and certified organic

name: The Market
desc:
The Market in Wolfville has cherished being part of this community for over 45 years. We are a surprising store with an excellent range of products that appeal to students, tourists and local residents alike. We strive to continually introduce new and fresh ideas. There is always something exciting in store to be discovered.

For the first time visitor, a browsing experience like no other awaits with every corner, every shelf brimming with products hard to find elsewhere. Here you will find everything from vinyl records, our house brand clothing, hats, jewelry, art, housewares, games and a cute smoke shop!

name: Troy Restaurant
desc:
Troy Restaurant and Grill provides a unique dining experience featuring a menu inspired by the Mediterranean. Our regionally sourced cuisine showcases the very best from local farmers and ranchers who are passionate about what they do and we respect the value and the quality of their ingredients.

Troy offers a diverse menu that can accommodate any appetite or dietary restriction, the valley's largest selection of local wines, an expansive cocktail list and Wolfville's largest patio! See you at Troy for lunch, dinner, or drinks!

name: Gingerbread House Inn
desc: Gingerbread House Bed & Breakfast has seven individually decorated, spacious rooms all with private entrances and bathrooms. Located a short 5 min walk into downtown with restaurants and shops, walking distance to Acadia University. Perfectly located to explore all the beauty Nova Scotia has to offer

Located on Wolfville’s Main Street, Harvest Gallery features a wonderfully diverse collection of art and fine craft from many of the region’s best-loved artists and artisans alongside work from some exciting new local talent.

Gathered here you’ll find original work by local painters, printmakers, photographers and folk artists as well as works in stone, ceramic, metal, wood, and fibre. The gallery is open year-round.

name: Lightfoot & Wolfville Vineyards
desc: Situated on the East end of the Town of Wolfville, Lightfoot & Wolfville Vineyards is one of Nova Scotia's newest wineries, having officially opened to the public in 2017. Family-owned and operated by an eighth generation farming family, Lightfoot & Wolfville identifies as a farm, winery, culinary destination and event venue. With close proximity to the Bay of Fundy and the world’s highest tides, coastal breezes and excellent temperature moderation help create wines with great distinction. The focus is on terroir-driven, certified organic (Ecocert) and biodynamic (Demeter) wines including Chardonnay, Pinot Noir, aromatic whites such as Riesling, and sparkling wines. The culinary program offers year-round dining experiences from exclusive events in the barrel cellar to an intimate lunch menu on the weekends in the shoulder season. The summer patio restaurant features a wood fired oven and ingredients sourced directly from the Lightfoot family farm & garden. The new hospitality and event facility, open for tastings and tours, features state-of-the-art, modern-barn inspired architecture with a stunning view of Cape Blomidon.

name: Wolfville Dentistry
desc:
At Wolfville Dentistry, we believe that your oral health is an important part of your overall mental and physical health. We take great pride in building trusting relationships with all our patients.

We believe that all good relationships start and stop with good communication and work hard to insure that is at the forefront of all our interactions.

We continually strive to provide a nurturing environment where all our patients can feel comfortable, respected, and valued

name: Inner Sun Yoga
desc: Inner sun Yoga has served Wolfville for over ten years. Our senior teachers have over 30 years of experience and mentor all of our newer teachers. We enjoy helping people learn balance and alignment in both body and mind. Our classes are suitable for experienced students who want to deepen their practice. We also have classes for people recovering from injury and any general weakness in the body

name: Buds and Bygones flower shops
desc: Local and fair trade flowers for all occasions. We strive to have the freshest and highest grade flowers. Our Plants are all very expertly maintained. Plus a wide selection of vases , pots, silks and baskets.

name: The Acadia Sports Therapy Clinic
desc: Participation in sports, fitness, and recreational activities is growing. Unfortunately, there is also an increase in injuries related to these activities. The Acadia Sports Therapy Clinic’s qualified and experienced staff evaluate, treat, and prevent injuries which occur as a result of these activities and enable individuals to pursue their sports, fitness, and recreational goals. Services are available to all members of the university community as well as the to the general public and no longer require a physician's referral

name: Victoria's Historic Inn
desc: While in Wolfville, stay at Nova Scotia's welcoming 5 star Bed and Breakfast Inn. This Victorian-designed home and carriage house is a landmark in Wolfville and has been providing lodging and welcoming guests from around the world for 50 years. We are proud to be a member of Unique Country Inns of Nova Scotia and are happy to serve you. Make your stay a memorable one

name: Cochrane's Pharmasave
desc:
Proudly serving local communities in the Annapolis Valley in Nova Scotia for over 85 years, Cochrane's Pharmasave provides professional healthcare services including foot care, free local prescription delivery, blood collection, and medical compounding.


Serving the Annapolis Valley since 1924, Cochrane's Pharmasave has three locations: Wolfville, Canning, and Hantsport NS.

In essence, Cochrane's Pharmasave truly is more than your average drug store; providing a wide-variety of essential health care services:

-Blood Collection
-In-Store & At-Home Foot Care
-Compliance & Blister Packaging
-One-on-One Pharmacist Medication Reviews
-Free Prescription Delivery Services
-Lift Chair & Home-Health Assistance
-Custom Bracing & Orthotic Fittings
-Pharmacist Hormone Consulting
-Innovative Custom Medication Solutions (Compounding).

In addition to all these services and our weekly flyer promotions we also run many in-store specials exclusive to Cochranes. So stop by today and let us serve you!

name: Grand Pre Wines
desc:
Located in the heart of Nova Scotia Wine Country, Domaine de Grand Pré is Atlantic Canada’s oldest Farm Winery, owned and operated by the Stutz Family since 1994. It was in 2000, after years of thoughtful renovation, that we first opened our hearts and doors as Domaine de Grand Pré. We’ve been welcoming visitors and delivering a Nova Scotia wine experience like none other ever since.

Our hope is that you’ll immediately feel welcome and want to spend time at Domaine de Grand Pré. Enjoy our lush gardens and immaculately tended vines, come for a tasting in our wine shop and relax in our inviting Le Caveau restaurant. A place of the Old World, European charm is carved into every stone. It’s a winery where time stands still.

name: Tiszta Viz Organic Skincare & Spa
desc:
We are an organic spa in the heart of Wolfville specializing in the Eminence Organic Skincare line. Their products are proudly free of parabens, animal by-products, propylene glycol, Sodium lauryl sulfates, harmful colorants and fragrances, mineral oils, petroleum, and other harsh cosmetic chemicals. We also carry Elate Cosmetics; they strive to make the ingredients as organic as possible but will always choose fair trade over organic if we are unable to have both. It is important to them that every person involved in the making of our cosmetics is treated ethically and fairly.

We have a variety of services available from facials and body treatments to manicure, pedicures and waxing.

Open 9-5 Tuesday through Friday, 5-8 by appointment. Open 9-3 Saturdays, until 5 by appointment. Open Mondays by appointment seasonally.

name: L'Arche Homefires
desc: L’Arche Homefires has been a thriving part of Wolfville, Nova Scotia for over 35 years. We are people with differing abilities sharing life in community with a wide circle of family, friends and neighbours. We provide supports for daily living, employment and community participation in 5 group homes, 3 Day Programs and an Independent Living Support program.

name: Vincent den Hartog Architect
desc: A full service Architecture firm, providing architecture and interior design from pre-design phase through to construction phase. Our projects are built throughout rural Nova Scotia. We have completed many renovation and addition projects to heritage type buildings, as well as designs for new homes. Some of our commercial clients include, Lightfoot & Wolfville Vineyards, Just Us Coffee, Annapolis Animal Hospital, Evangeline Inn & Motel, Chrismaria Restaurant. If your project will benefit from great design, give us a call. We would love to discuss your plans.

name: Microboutique Living
desc:
What is MICRO Boutique Living? We believe that less can be better, and small is smart. Our cutting-edge design meets out-of-the-box thinking to create modern, fully-furnished suites that are minimal, yet highly functional. Whether you are looking for a hotel for a few days, a space for a season, or a year-round home, Micro Boutique Living has everything you need.

Currently we are offering month to month accommodations with immediate availability through to the end of August. With hopes that the state of emergency will be lifted soon and travel will begin, we will open our hotel to overnight guests.

Given the current situation with Covid-19 we are also offering secure and isolated suites to those working in the medical field. Should a front line worker need to be isolated for the safety of their families we will provide them with a substantial discount.
